name: Volatility Exhaustion Fade
hypothesis: In non-trending regimes, an M15 volatility climax (range > 1.6 ATR, elevated tick volume, extreme close) that breaks the 20-bar extreme after a six-bar run exhausts locally and reverts toward the recent mean.
risk_model: One planned risk unit; stop at climax extreme plus 0.15 M15 ATR buffer; risk 0.6-5 ATR; no broker execution
planned_rr: 12-bar mean target or 2.2R structural fallback; admitted only at planned RR >= 2
known_limitations: No verified positive edge; H1 efficiency-ratio regime filter is coarse; fades can run in trending regimes despite the filter; CFD spread proxies; missing histories remain unresolved; tick volume is not centralized volume. Version history: 0.2.0: H1 efficiency cap 0.35->0.28; volume confirmation 1.3x->1.6x median; horizon 24h->18h.
